subunit: Homoheptamer arranged in a ring structure. The functional units of these chaperonins consist of heptameric rings of the large subunit Hsp60, which function as a back-to-back double ring. Interacts with 2 heptameric Hsp10 rings to form the symmetrical football complex. Interacts with HRAS. Interacts with ATAD3A. Interacts with ETFBKMT and EEF1AKMT3. Interacts with MFHAS1
